comment: Chinese keywords for .luacn (opened as Lua). Whole words only (not inside a Chinese name like 存在 or 当前), and never in comments or strings.

patterns.comment: Control flow keywords — 否则如果 must appear before 否则
patterns.name: keyword.control.lua
patterns.match: (?<![\p{L}\p{N}_])(否则如果|如果|那么|否则|结束|当|重复|直到|对于|在|做|函数|返回|本地|令|中断)(?![\p{L}\p{N}_])
